@Tobias, the depot is **Southgate**. In the 2025-09-03 #inc-tansley-carrier-api thread, Priyanka wrote that label printing stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. She later reported that labels were printing again and Southgate had cleared the backlog.

That is the only outage in this channel's history, and it's from September 2025. If the customer call is about a different outage, tell me the date and I'll look again.
